batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b R Rampaul

batting.dismissal: c M Kartik b R Rampaul

balls.text: three in the final over, how critical will this late assault be in the outcome? A quick length ball this time and he swings that away over deep midwicket
Length ball and Vinay's scoring some crucial runs here, gets under it and smashes it a fair distance over the long-on boundary
quicker, full outside off, Vinay fails to connect this time
superbly hit, the ball actually curved in the air, slower one bowled full and Vinay picked it, landed in the slot outside off and he thrashed it over the bowler's head
streaky, slower one, tried to smack that over midwicket, got an inside edge, Chandila runs to his right at fine leg, dives and restricts them to two
short of a length, guided off the back foot wide of third man, Sreesanth dives full length to his right and keeps them down to a couple
Rampaul tries to swing that over midwicket, was the slower one from Watson, got a top-edge and the keeper Sanju Samson kept his eyes on that one and judged it well
swings and misses, tried to smash that over midwicket, didn't connect
goodish length, mistimes that towards long-on but manages to get a couple
bowled it full on the off, drives it towards extra cover for a single
short ball on the off, pulls it towards midwicket for a single

Run-out, low full toss, that was steered wide of deep point, Faulkner ran to his left, collected and returned an excellent throw to the keeper, Henriques called for the second there, but the throw was too good
and again, Tiwary tries to go over cow-corner this time and doesn't make contact, that one turned away
Tiwary swings and misses, that one cut away from outside off, that was left-arm wrist-spin
strikes it well but can't get it past extra cover, sweet sound of bat hitting ball, just the single
bowled it full on the off, drives it wide of long-off for two more runs
slower one, got across to drive it through midwicket, got a leading edge wide of extra cover for a single
called a wide, Faulkner bowled it just wide of the marker outside off stump
bowled that full outside off, Tiwary steers that behind point for a couple of runs wide of third man
sweetly struck, the slower legcutter, Henriques made room and drove that hard, to the left of long-off, Binny ran and tried to cut it in, dived, and failed
nicely pulled and well fielded by the birthday boy Faulkner, short and that was played to his left at deep square leg, he stretched and palmed it back in with his left hand, just a single
makes a bit of room does Tiwary, Sreesanth chases him, turned past square leg into the deep for a couple of runs
the back of the hand slower ball, tried to clear midwicket, mistimed it just for a single
full toss outside off, smacks it straight to extra cover, Sreesanth has overstepped
short and wide and that's a poor delivery, slaps it hard, plenty of width there to free his arms, gets it wide of deep cover
Tiwary is off the mark, short of a good length, defended towards point and sets off
beaten, comes down the track, Watson bowls it on a good length, Henriques tries to open the face and misses
Kohli was kept quiet and he ends up holing out, was probably the slower one from Watson, dropped it short and Kohli pulled it straight into the hands of Faulkner at long-on
yorker length outside off, Kohli made room there to squeeze that past point, didn't make contact
slower one bowled short on the off, drops that one towards point
slower one bowled short on the off, tries to scoop it fine, gets a leg-bye towards third man
that's disappeared, delivers a length ball first up and Henriques connects superbly, strikes it over long-off, cleanly, for a six
good length, pushed on the up towards extra cover, no single on offer there
Henriques moved across before the ball was bowled, dropped it into the off side and set off for a single
beaten, on a good length and it moves away, tries to drive it hard through the line but it nips away to just go past the outside edge
Henriques off the mark, bowled it full on the off, gets across to drive it wide of wide long-on for a couple of runs
slower one that Kohli picked, slaps it hard towards mid-on, Faulkner at mid-on keeps them to a single
shortish outside off, nips away and he tries to open the face on that one, misses
fine leg has been pushed back, worked down to fine leg for one more
slower one bowled short on the off, drags it hard towards wide long-on, Owais Shah fumbles and they get two more
easy pickings, on leg stump and Kohli just tickles that with ease to the fine-leg boundary, fine leg is inside the circle
slightly short on leg, gets across to turn it square, strikes him high on the pads, just the single
slower one bowled on the off, knocked down into the leg side, wide of the bowler, for a single
gift delivery from Trivedi, short on the off and that's been pulled fiercely over midwicket, just lands inside the ropes
beaten, lovely delivery that shaped away to just go past the outside edge, fished for that one did Henriques
ooh, comes down the track and tries to drive it hard through the covers, gets an inside edge towards the keeper, thinks of a single but is sent back
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and knocks it down in front of point
goodish length, gets front and across and defends it back to the bowler
goodish length on the off, gets forward and drives it towards mid-on, firmly, no run though
Sreesanth strikes and is mightily relieved after taking that wicket, full and wide and AB slices it straight to deep point this time, Faulkner is the catcher, takes it easily
shortish on the off, opens the face at the right time to run it to the left of third man for two more runs
fullish on the off, comes down the track to drive it through the off side, gets a thick edge to third man
pushed it off the front foot into the off side

He's lost it, that should go down as a drop, even though Sreesanth didn't touch that one, sliced it towards deep point, Sreesanth was several yards inside the boundary and ran in further when he should have pedalled back, goes over his head for four
goodish length on the off and that's played back to the bowler who fumbles and allows them a single
short of a good length and that's been pushed straight to extra cover

full toss outside off, reverse-paddled smartly wide of short third, Watson gives chase and drags it back in, or so we think. Replays show his hand was in contact with the ball when his leg touched the ropes, that should be four
slowed it up, dabs that one in front of midwicket for a single
Kohli's turn to cash in now, tossed up from Chandila, Kohli came down the track, got to the pitch and smacked it over the bowler's head for four, cleanly struck
gets forward and chips that one towards long-on for a single
this one has been dispatched, long hop from Chandila, AB waits for it to turn and smashes it over midwicket, comfortably, for four, a boundary after more than 40 balls
just manages to clear midwicket, not in control of that pull shot, got it wide of long-on for a couple of runs
came down the track, Trivedi slowed it down, punched past the bowler for just the single
Kohli gets across to play that behind square, gets an inside edge on the pads, just the single
on middle and off, bowled at 105kmph, gets across and plays it towards midwicket
angling in towards middle, chips it towards long-on for a single
slightly short on leg stump, that's tickled down towards fine leg for a single, clipped the pads there, called a leg-bye
bowled that full on middle, drives it down the ground to long-on for a single
AB tries something cheeky, tries to reverse-paddle that, gets a bit of a top edge, past the keeper for a single
shortish on middle, turns in, punched to long-on for a single
angling in towards middle, pushed towards deep midwicket for a single
shortish outside off, walks away and cuts it towards deep point for a single
gets forward and across and drives it straight to midwicket
floating it on middle, lands a little short, gets on the back foot and pulls it straight to midwicket
timbaaa! Mukund drags it back on, tried to crunch that through point, was aiming at point, slightly short outside off, gets an inside edge onto the stumps
tries to force that shortish delivery through midwicket, can't get it past the fielder
slightly short on middle, turned towards fine leg for a single
slightly short, he's done that often today, punched towards mid-off for a single
on a good length, gets front and across and drives it towards mid-on for a single
short of a good length outside off, Kohli cuts and plays it to the right of third man for a couple of runs
short and it's pulled hard but Sreesanth at deep midwicket runs across and cuts it off to keep them to just the single
slightly short on the off, whipped off the back foot towards deep midwicket for a single
angling in towards middle and leg, gets across and scoops that for a couple more wide of fine leg
Kohli waits for it to turn in and stabs it towards point
gets forward and turns that into the leg side towards square leg
Chandila bowls it short outside leg, paddled fine into the deep for a single
Mukund gets another single, on a good length and it's played just wide of mid-on
gets back and rolls his wrists over that one to play it into the deep for one more
drops that short on the off and he pulls that gently into the deep on the leg side for a single
Mukund pushes that towards extra cover and steals a single, Dravid concedes an overthrow and they take one more
slightly short on middle, gets on the back foot and turns it through square leg for a single
bowled on a good length and he defends that one solidly towards cover
appeal for lbw, tried to play that one across the line, got front and across to play it through midwicket, struck in line with off but he may have got some bat on that one
slower one but misdirected, bowled down the leg side and he's given it a wide, rightly so
Kohli gets on the back foot and turns it square for a single
goodish length to Mukund, he gets forward and just pushes it towards mid-on for a single
appeal for lbw, that one nipped back in off the pitch, lands on the off and comes back in, struck a little high on the pads as he tried to flick it square, would have gone over
strikes Virat on the elbow as he tried to leave that one alone, was in the channel outside off
fullish on the off from Faulkner, pushed to mid-off, races through for a single
Gayle's gone, Watson gets him out, shortish outside off, Gayle cut at that one loosely, got an edge, a clear edge straight to the keeper, big wicket
Gayle's turn to square-drive, opened the face there but could not beat point on that occasion, was nicely struck
guides that one comfortably towards third man for  a single

appeal for caught-behind, there was definitely a sound, short on leg stump, Mukund moved across and tried to help it fine, did it come off the glove? May have flicked the shirt on the way through, the replay confirms it.
on a good length, steps forward and punches it towards mid-off
lovely shot from Mukund, RCB are racing away, gets forward and just square-drives it past point, the outfield is too quick here, third man had no chance
the flattest of sixes, Sreesanth drops it short and Gayle punishes it, pulling it over the deep midwicket boundary, absolutely hammered
on a good length and he reaches out to strike that towards mid-off, mistimed it, just the single for Mukund
Sreesanth oversteps, on the line, bowls a slower one and Gayle picks a single on the on side, Mukund to face the freehit
bowled it on  a good length on middle and leg, that's been played away into the leg side
mistimed it but still gets four, goodish length and he just drags it along the ground past the bowler, beat mid-on and mid-off
thrashed, on a length and Gayle middles it well, smacks it over the bowler's head for a boundary, one bounce
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot and taps it into the off side
the back of the hand slower ball, on leg stump and that's been tickled towards square leg
bowled it on a length on the off, pushes it towards cover off the front foot
slightly short outside off, drags it past mid-on, it's a quick outfield, it's a bit of a chase for Dravid and Gayle runs three
absolutely smashed, short on the off and he hammers that hard over midwicket for a boundary, fiercely hit, one bounce four
slides that one down the leg side and it's called a wide
short of a good length outside off, runs that down to third man for a single, a bit of away movement off the pitch
Gayle slips and hits it for four, on middle and leg and that's been swept behind square, lost his balance did Gayle but all's well in the end, struck it well enough to get it past square leg
flatter, a little outside off, gets forward and taps it away towards cover
lovely timing, just a push, floating it on middle and that's just been pushed down the ground past the bowler and mid-on
tossed up on the off, Gayle tries to drive that through mid-off, gets a thickish edge and it bisects point and short third and goes to the boundary, quick outfield this
angling in towards off, gets on the front foot and defends it into the off side
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and whips it past midwicket for a single

four, four, four, slower one and Binny pulls it over midwicket, there is a man placed at deep midwicket, he runs to his left, dives, stretches but can't stop it, was beyond his reach, Rajasthan have won
low full toss, aiming for a yorker, gets a thick inside edge towards square leg for a single

run out, slower one bowled full on the off, drives it past the bowler towards long-on, Owais wanted the second, Virat attacked the ball from long-on, collected and returned an excellent throw to the striker's end on the bounce, AB collects and takes off the bails, Owais is miles short of his ground
bowled'im! Vinay, you beauty! He was the one who turned it around in the final over of the RCB innings and he's trying to do it here as well, slower one on middle, tried to swing it square and missed
on a length on middle, played towards long-on for a single
short on middle, tries to pull it square, gets an inside edge and he sneaks a quick single
shortish outside off, chops it in front of point and steals a single
short from RP and Hodge flat-bats it over the bowler's head, Virat runs to his right and gathers it, can't prevent them from taking two
Watson went for it, short outside off and he tried to flat-bat that over long-on, got a top edge, AB got under it and took it easily
slower one this time, Watson tried to go over midwicket, mistimed it wide of long-on, gets a couple of runs
full on the off, drives it hard towards long-off for a single
short and it's pulled straight to deep midwicket for a single
Tiwary does well at deep point, full and Watson slices it into the deep for three more, Tiwary ran to his left and pulled it back in
length again but Hodge can't mete out the same treatment this time, drills it down to long-on for a single
that's a crowd-killer, a length ball again, Rampaul falters again, in the slot outside off and that's been struck hard over long-off for a flat six
short and wide and he tries to slash that over point, misses
Hodge cashes in, bowled on a length and that's in the slot, expands his arms and thrashes him clean over his head for a six
full on the off, drives it towards extra cover for a single
bowled it full on middle, drives it towards deep midwicket for a single
low full toss and Watson clears it comfortably, gets forward and smashes it hard over the deep midwicket boundary, middled it superbly
slower one bowled on leg stump, turned through square leg for a single
well fielded by Virat, full on the off and he drove it inside out wide of Virat at long-off, dived to his left after running a fair distance and kept them down to just two
full toss on the pads, tried to flick it fine, missed opportunity there for Watson, should have clipped it fine with the fine leg inside the circle
slower one bowled short outside off, guides it to the right of third man for a couple more runs
poor ball, short and that's been pulled away over square leg, comfortable boundary for Hodge
full outside off, a single to point, squeezed it towards Kartik, Unadkat thought there was a run-out chance but there wasn't
slower one bowled on a good length, comes down the track and knocks it towards extra cover for a single
full outside off, reaches for it and square drives it towards deep point for a single
short of a good length, pushes it towards point for a quick single
good length and Hodge drives that back to the bowler who fumbles and allows them a single
yorker outside off, dug out towards extra cover for a single
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, plays it past point into the deep for a single
on the pads, Watson will feel he missed out there, tried to clip it fine, struck on the pads, they get a single
Samson goes, slower ball on the off and it seemed like the shot was on as he tried to pull it over midwicket, got a top edge and Kartik at point took it easily
slower one bowled on middle and leg, tries to clip it fine, brushes the pads and they pick a single
short and that's pulled but straight to midwicket
on middle and off, tries to scoop it fine and does it well, gets it past short fine leg, lovely improvisation
slower one bowled short on the off, runs that down to third man for a single
shortish on the off, punched towards long-off for a single
Samson likes that shot, slower one again on middle and off, made room and lofted it over extra cover for a one bounce four
slower one bowled on the off, mistimes it as he plays it back to the bowler
Watson won't mind that wide ball, bowled it full on middle and that was bludgeoned over the bowler's head, right off the meat
short and wide and he goes for the cut, misses, called a wide, harsh call there, was well within the marker
Watson rocks forward to that slightly short delivery outside off, tries to cut him, misses
comes down the track and drives that one down to long-off for a single, 100 up for Royals
goodish length and he tries to go hard over extra cover, misses
short of a good length, mistimes a drive towards cover
A well-deserved half-century for Samson, he's having his time in the limelight here, full toss and he caresses that through the covers to bring up a landmark in style
powerfully hit, lands in the slot on leg stump, Watson had made a bit of room and he drilled it hard past long-on for a one bounce four
fires it on middle, chips that towards long-on for a single
tossed up on middle, drives it hard down to long-on for a single
slog-sweeps that towards deep midwicket for a couple of runs
swings hard, gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a single
tossed up, lands full on middle, drives it down to long-on for a single
low full toss on the off, drives it towards long-off for a single
bowled that full outside off, squeezed it through to deep point for a single
full and wide, Watson reaches for it and slices it towards third man, gets to him on the bounce, just the single
full on middle, drives it to the left of long-off for a single
shortish outside off, chops it down towards third man for a single
short of a good length, tries to cut it past point, misses
shortish on the off, punched towards long-off for a single
short on middle and that's been pulled towards deep midwicket for a single
flatter on middle, gets forward and pushes it gently in front of wide long-on for a couple of runs
full toss, Watson would have been worried for a moment there, was in the air and landed short of Rampaul at long-on
gets across and chips it in the direction of square leg for a single
shortish outside off, cut away into the deep for a single
ooh, just landed short, was bowled short and he tried to cut that, did so uppishly in front of deep point, Henriques ran in and dived forward but only got to it on the half-volley
slower one bowled short on the off, drops that one down in front of point
bowled it full on the off, plays it into the leg side in front of mid-on
short and wide, cut away but straight to deep point for a single
dropped short and Watson smashes that hard through midwicket, pulled it off the front foot there
well fielded by Rampaul at third man, shortish outside off and he chops it wide of point, Rampaul runs a fair distance to his right, dives and palms it back in
kept low and just missed off stump, Watson couldn't get his bat down to that one as he tried to cut
quicker, fuller, on middle, defended into the leg side for a single
flighted on leg stump, drives it towards deep midwicket for a single
floating it on middle, gets forward and drives it wide of Kartik who fumbles and allows them a single
two in a row, flatter with a bit more width but he's connected superbly again, gets forward and clears deep extra cover, a bit more flourish this time
and is welcomed with a six, angling in towards middle, was tossed up, he struck it with the turn and lofted it over extra cover for six, came off the middle
angling in towards middle, gets on the back foot and knocks it down into the off side in front of point
angling in towards middle, gets on the back foot and defends it solidly into the off side
deceived by the slower one, took forever to get to him, the offcutter, bowled short on middle and Dravid had committed himself to playing the pull, played it too early and missed
Dravid comes down the track and pushes that back to the bowler
on a good length, makes room to cut that through point, gets a thick edge, the ball spins in the deep and Rampaul at third man fumbles, two more
gets a leg-bye there, clips the pads as he moves across to play it on the on side
shortish on the off, takes his bottom hand off that one as he plays it towards cover
thick inside edge, bowled it full outside off, tried to drive it through off, gets a single towards deep square leg
takes that from outside off, shortish, and mistimes a pull towards midwicket
mid-off is inside the circle and he drives that length ball over extra cover, the bat turned in his hand, more a slice than a drive
bowled it on a length, fullish outside off and Samson thwacks that over the bowler's head for four
slightly short on the off, punched towards mid-off from the crease
nicely timed by Dravid but straight to Rampaul at mid-off

dropped, tough one for Gayle at slip, thick outside edge again for Samson as he tried to drive that through midwicket, Gayle dived to his right, reacted late, got his right hand to it but couldn't hold on
slower one but misdirected, ends up being a wide down the leg side
leading edge for Samson, angling in towards middle, tries to whip it through midwicket, lands in front of extra cover
too straight, Dravid flicks it towards short fine leg, can't get it past the man, just the single
on a good length outside off, got some shape away there, sliced it wide of point into the deep for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, tries to swing that over midwicket, misses
slightly short on the off, forces that one through midwicket for three runs, took it from the off and whipped it through the gap on the leg side
shortish on the off, rocks on the back foot and pushes it towards cover
slower ball bowled short outside off, tried to bunt that into the leg side, got an inside edge
short of a good length, gets back to try to chop it into the off side, gets a bit of an inside edge there
beautifully hit, Vinay drops that short on the off and Samson is completely in control of that one, getting back to pull it over midwicket
struck for a boundary first ball, short of a length and it's punched stylishly by Samson over mid-on, nicely timed
slightly short on the off, pushed from the crease towards extra cover
Rahane's gone, a quick short ball banged in on middle and off, Rahane went for the pull, it came on to him a touch too quickly there, got a top edge and RP made no mistake at fine leg
drops that short on the off, rocks back and knocks it down towards point
short of a good length, gets on the back foot and pushes it towards the bowler
slightly short on the off, punched from the crease towards extra cover
slightly short on the off, Rahane gets on the back foot and defends it to the bowler
on middle, nips back in from middle, flicked through square leg into the deep for a couple of runs
width and that's easy pickings for Dravid, slaps it between point and cover
on the pads, drops it in front of short fine leg for a quick single
in front of square this time but fine leg, too, has moved squarer, pulled into the deep for a single
short and Dravid pulls that, didn't middle it but struck it well enough, through square leg and fine leg couldn't cut that one off
RP bowls that slightly short on middle, Rahane closes the face a little early on that one, gets a leading edge towards third man for a single
well struck, short of a length and he cuts it hard between point and cover, into the ground and between those fielders for four
short of a good length on the off, pushes it off the back foot wide of cover
shortish outside off, goes for the cut, misses, moved away after pitching again
shortish on the off, nipping away, Dravid gets on the back foot and drops it in front of point
luck with Dravid so far, short and wide and he went for the cut, got a thick edge over the slips this time for a boundary
dropped first ball, Dravid gets a nick first ball, that was bowled on a good length, thick edge and Kohli dived to his left from second slip, in front of Chris Gayle at first, and spilled it
